title: Quantification of adipocyte numbers in transgenic mice via the Cre-LoxP recombination sites
protocol: Add two stainless steel metal beads per sample to the 2 mL Eppendorf tube.
Add 1 mL of NaOH (50 mM) to the samples.
Lysate the samples for 5–10 minutes with the TissueLyser LT.
Check that the tissue is fully lysed.
Repeat lysis for another 5 minutes if necessary.
Shake the samples in a thermoshaker for 1 hour at 1000 rpm and 92°C.
Spin the tubes to remove condensation from the lid.
Add 250 μL of Tris-HCl (1 M, pH 8) to neutralize the pH.
Centrifuge the samples at 13000 rcf for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Carefully move through the layer of fat and transfer part of the aqueous phase to a fresh tube.
Transfer 200 μL of the aqueous phase to a fresh tube.
If fat is sticking to the outside of the pipet tip, carefully remove the fat with a paper tissue before transferring the aqueous phase to a fresh tube.
Centrifuge the samples again at 13000 rcf for 5 min at 4°C.
Carefully transfer 2 μL of the aqueous phase from the samples to 58 μL of H2O to obtain a 1:30 dilution of the genomic DNA.
Prepare a standard curve from the pUC57recloxPRed-ApoB plasmid.
Conduct qPCR testing of the standard curve before assaying samples.
Mix 2 μL of sample or standard with the primer mix.
Add 1 μL of primer mix to each well.
Pipette 2 μL of H2O into each well.
Dispense 5 μL of Fast SYBR Green Mastermix into each well.
Run the Fast SYBR Green program on the qPCR machine.
Set the threshold for LoxPRed samples and ApoB samples at the same value within the geometric phase of amplification.
